title: Quantity values
description: Polymorphic value shape discriminated by 'kind'. Per OBJECT-MODEL.md §7. Two top-level entry points: 'value' (any kind including unknown_user_supplied) and 'value_strict' (excludes unknown_user_supplied, for builtin/community origins per anti-placeholder Rule 2).

scalar.description: A single numeric value with a unit.

range.description: A min/max range with optional typical and distribution.

condition_bound.description: A value that holds under specific conditions (temperature, frequency, etc.). Conditions block is required and non-empty.

equation.description: A closed-form expression with named inputs and an output unit.

curve.description: A parameterized function shape (Arrhenius, Caughey-Thomas, etc.).

lookup_table.description: Discrete data points with an interpolation rule.

unknown_user_supplied.description: User-typed value with no provenance. RESTRICTED: allowed only at user_local and project origins. Builtin and community schemas use 'value_strict' which excludes this kind.

value.description: A polymorphic value — discriminated by 'kind'. Use this where any kind is allowed (user_local, project).

value_strict.description: Like 'value' but excludes unknown_user_supplied. Use for builtin and community origins per anti-placeholder Rule 2.

param_value.description: Polymorphic parameter value. For quantity-typed parameters: a quantity 'value'. For material_ref / shape_ref / object_ref / enum / string types: a bare string id. For numeric scalars expressed bare: a number. For bool: a boolean. Use this for instance parameter values and definition parameter defaults at user_local/project origins.

param_value_strict.description: Like 'param_value' but uses 'value_strict' (excludes unknown_user_supplied). Use for definition parameter defaults at builtin/community origins per anti-placeholder Rule 2.
